deals.title: What the Previews Are Saying About Gears of War: E-Day
deals.excerpt: Hands-on previews for Gears of War: E-Day are live, and early reactions to the new Horde mode and campaign are overwhelmingly positive.
deals.translation_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》试玩前瞻汇总：新 Horde 模式与战役反响热烈。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》试玩体验陆续公开，玩家对全新 Horde 模式与单人战役反响热烈。

deals.title: Gears of War: E-Day Horde Siege Mode Is Addictive, Previews Say
deals.excerpt: The new Horde Siege mode in Gears of War: E-Day is winning over previewers, who can't stop playing the co-op survival mode.
deals.translation_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》新 Horde 围攻模式上手体验：令人欲罢不能的联机生存玩法。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》全新 Horde 围攻模式在试玩中获得一致好评，合作生存玩法令人上瘾。

deals.title: Monopoly Go x The Simpsons Crossover Event Launching Soon
deals.excerpt: Monopoly Go teams up with The Simpsons for a new crossover event, bringing Springfield-themed content to the popular mobile game.
deals.translation_zh: 《大富翁GO》联动《辛普森一家》即将开启，春田镇主题内容来袭。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《大富翁GO》与《辛普森一家》联动活动即将上线，为这款热门手游带来春田镇主题内容。

deals.title: Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.3 Adds New Story Chapter and Character
deals.excerpt: Version 4.3 of Honkai: Star Rail brings a new story chapter and makes Mortenax Blade playable, launching June 1 for all players.
deals.translation_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.3 版本新增剧情章节，Mortenax Blade 角色登场，6月1日上线。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.3 版本带来全新剧情章节，Mortenax Blade 成为可玩角色，6月1日全平台上线。

deals.title: Forza Horizon 6 Review: Still the Best Driving Game — With One Catch
deals.excerpt: Forza Horizon 6 keeps its crown as the most accessible racing game around, though the car-collecting progression system remains divisive.
deals.translation_zh: 《极限竞速：地平线6》评测：依然是最易上手的赛车游戏——但有一个槽点。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《极限竞速：地平线6》继续保持最亲民赛车游戏的称号，但车辆收集养成系统仍存在争议。

deals.title: Genshin Impact's Luna 7 Update Introduces First Playable Hexenzirkel
deals.excerpt: Genshin Impact's upcoming Luna 7 update brings major Sumeru story developments and the first playable Hexenzirkel member.
deals.translation_zh: 《原神》Luna 7 版本更新：首位可玩的魔女会成员登场，须弥剧情迎来转折。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《原神》即将到来的 Luna 7 版本带来须弥重大剧情发展，并推出首位可玩的魔女会成员。

deals.title: Petit Planet: HoYoverse's First Family-Friendly Game Impressions
deals.excerpt: A hands-on look at Petit Planet, HoYoverse's first attempt at a family-friendly title — careful, charming, and colouring within the lines.
deals.translation_zh: 《Petit Planet》前瞻：米哈游首款家庭友好向游戏初体验，精致而稳妥。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《Petit Planet》试玩前瞻：米哈游首款家庭友好向游戏，精致可爱且谨慎稳妥。

deals.title: Diablo 4's Next Season Skips New Mechanics to Focus on Expansion
deals.excerpt: Blizzard confirms Diablo 4's next season won't add new mechanics, with all development focus on the Lord of Hatred expansion.
deals.translation_zh: 《暗黑破坏神4》下赛季不加新机制，全力开发《仇恨之王》资料片。
deals.excerpt_zh: 暴雪确认《暗黑破坏神4》下一赛季将不加入新机制，全部开发资源集中于《仇恨之王》资料片。

deals.title: Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred Review — A Compelling, Cinematic Conclusion
deals.excerpt: The Lord of Hatred expansion delivers a compelling conclusion to Diablo 4's story with the cinematic panache that proves Blizzard still has it.
deals.translation_zh: 《暗黑破坏神4：仇恨之王》评测：引人入胜的史诗终章，证明暴雪宝刀未老。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《仇恨之王》资料片为《暗黑破坏神4》的故事线带来精彩收尾，电影级表现证明暴雪实力犹存。

deals.title: The Sims 4 Paid Mods Roll Out to Consoles, Kits Return to PC
deals.excerpt: The Sims 4's controversial paid mods system has finally arrived on consoles, while Kits are making a return to PC.
deals.translation_zh: 《模拟人生4》付费 Mod 系统登陆主机，PC 版 Kits 套件回归。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《模拟人生4》备受争议的付费模组系统终于登陆主机平台，PC 版 Kits 套件同步回归。

deals.title: Metro 2039 Returns to Underground Roots With a Powerful New Story
deals.excerpt: Metro 2039 goes back to the series' underground survival roots, with a narrative shaped by the war in Ukraine and its human cost.
deals.translation_zh: 《地铁2039》回归地下生存本源，以乌克兰战争为背景的震撼叙事。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《地铁2039》回归系列地下生存的本源，其叙事深受乌克兰战争及其人道影响所塑造。

deals.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons Adds Free 25th Anniversary Item
deals.excerpt: Nintendo celebrates Animal Crossing's 25th anniversary with a new free in-game item for New Horizons players.
deals.translation_zh: 《集合啦！动物森友会》推出25周年纪念免费道具。
deals.excerpt_zh: 任天堂为庆祝《动物森友会》系列25周年，向《集合啦！动物森友会》玩家发放全新免费纪念道具。

deals.title: Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.2 Kicks Off Third Anniversary Celebrations
deals.excerpt: Honkai: Star Rail players are in for a treat as Version 4.2 launches alongside the game's third anniversary celebrations later this month.
deals.translation_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.2 版本与三周年庆典同步开启，玩家福利满满。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.2 版本将于本月与游戏三周年庆典同步上线，玩家福利丰厚。

deals.title: Love and Deepspace: Caleb's Third Myth Arrives for Fans
deals.excerpt: Love and Deepspace adds Caleb's long-awaited third Myth storyline, delivering good news for fans of the popular romance character.
deals.translation_zh: 《恋与深空》凯列第三条神话线终于上线，角色粉迎来好消息。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《恋与深空》推出人气角色凯列的第三条神话剧情线，为角色粉丝带来好消息。

deals.title: Xbox UK and Europe Console Price Hikes Revealed — Worse Than Expected
deals.excerpt: Microsoft has revealed new Xbox console prices for the UK and Europe, and the increases are even steeper than analysts predicted.
deals.translation_zh: Xbox 英国与欧洲主机涨价公布，涨幅超预期。
deals.excerpt_zh: 微软公布 Xbox 主机在英国及欧洲地区的新售价，涨幅超出分析师预期。

deals.title: Gears of War: E-Day's New Horde Mode Raises Big Questions
deals.excerpt: While the new Horde mode in Gears of War: E-Day is the most interesting yet, it also leaves several gameplay questions unanswered.
deals.translation_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》全新 Horde 模式虽有趣，却留下了不少待解的玩法疑问。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》全新 Horde 模式被评最有创意，但也留下了不少待解答的玩法疑问。
